checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 5 seconds long and follows the first 5 seconds of talk-one.mp4
must.why: Stated as 5 s. The kitchen, pose and hand motions look the same as the source across the sampled frames.

must.item: Face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg throughout, without reverting
must.why: The face looks different from the original woman, so something was swapped. It only weakly resembles the portrait, which has a rounder face, darker features and heavy brows. It reads as a generic, blended face.

must.item: Kitchen, body motion and framing remain; hair and clothing may follow the portrait
must.why: The background, framing, sweater and brown wavy hair are all preserved.
The clip has sound with a peak of -0.9 dB, but the words and sync cannot be judged from stills. The mouth shapes vary plausibly.

must.item: Face stays aligned during mouth and head movement, without flicker or doubled features
must.why: In the four sampled frames the face is well aligned, including the head tilt at 2 s, with no visible doubling. Flicker between frames cannot be judged.

faults.what: The swapped face has weak identity match to the portrait. The portrait woman has a rounder face, strong dark brows and dark eyes. The output face looks narrower and lighter, close to a generic face.
The face skin tone and sharpness look slightly different from the neck and body, which gives mild AI smoothness.

summary: The clip keeps the original kitchen, framing and motion with a stable swapped face, but the new face barely resembles the portrait woman.
